title: EE60023: Power System Analysis And Operation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Power System Load Flow – Sparse Matrix Techniques. AC/DC power flow studies.
Optimal power flow analysis. State Estimation - static as well as dynamic.
Generation operation-load forecasting, Economic operation, Unit Commitment.
Operational security and reliability considerations. Transmission and
Distribution operation, deregulation.
